name: Donchian-Chandelier Breakout (Corrected)
description: Long-only breakout strategy using lagged Donchian channels for genuine breakout signals, with dual exit system combining Chandelier trailing stops and technical breakdown signals. Features volatility-adjusted position sizing for consistent 2% risk per trade.
source:
# Data source
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# Donchian Channel (20-period) - fetches its own OHLCV data
dc_upper, dc_middle, dc_lower = donchian_channel(window=20)()

# ATR for position sizing and stops (5-period) - fetches its own OHLCV data
atr_5 = atr(period=5)()

# Chandelier Exit (using 5-period ATR with 3x multiplier) - fetches its own OHLCV data
chandelier_long, chandelier_short, chandelier_dir = chandelier_exit(length=22, atr_length=5, multiplier=3.0)()

# Entry Logic: Close > yesterday's Donchian upper band (lagged by 1)
lagged_dc_upper = dc_upper >> 1
long_entry = close > lagged_dc_upper

# Exit Logic A: Chandelier Stop - Close < trailing stop
chandelier_exit_signal = close < chandelier_long

# Exit Logic B: Technical Breakdown - Close < yesterday's Donchian lower band
lagged_dc_lower = dc_lower >> 1
technical_exit = close < lagged_dc_lower

# Combined exit signal
exit_signal = chandelier_exit_signal or technical_exit

# Hold signal for long positions
held_long = hold_until()(enter=long_entry, exit=exit_signal)

# Entry/Exit zones - long only
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long)

# Risk Management: 2% risk, stop distance = 3 × ATR(5)
stop_distance = 3 * atr_5
risk_unit(rr_ratio=2.0)(risk_pct=2.0, stop_distance=stop_distance)

# Event Markers - Long Entry
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Long Entry Signals",
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Long Entry", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="DC Upper (Lagged)", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="ATR(5)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4)
        ]
    )
)(long_entry, close, lagged_dc_upper, atr_5)

# Event Markers - Chandelier Stop Exit
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Chandelier Stop Exits",
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Chandelier Exit", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Chandelier Stop", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(chandelier_exit_signal, close, chandelier_long)

# Event Markers - Technical Exit
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Technical Breakdown Exits",
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Technical Exit", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="DC Lower (Lagged)", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(technical_exit, close, lagged_dc_lower)
